intro.title: Capstone
intro.text: Tchaikovsky's Old French Song (1878), which you haven't heard here. No Listen button: learn it the way you'll learn any piece from now on.

intro.title: 1. Scan
intro.text: Key: G minor (two flats; F♯ is the raised 7th). Time: 2/4 with a one-note pickup. Find the highest and lowest notes and any repeated bars: bars 9–15 repeat bars 1–7.

intro.title: 2. Rhythm, then hands alone
intro.text: Practice at a slow tempo with the metronome. Pick 2–4 bars, turn on Loop, and play the right hand alone (Practice → Hands), then the left.

intro.title: 3. Together, then faster
intro.text: Hands together on the same bars, slowly. When a loop is clean twice in a row, add 4 BPM. Move on to the next bars and join them up.

intro.title: 4. Perform
intro.text: Play the whole piece in Scored play. That's the workflow for any sheet music: scan, slow, small chunks, hands alone, together, then speed.

credit: Notes from the Mutopia Project edition (Tchaikovsky, Op. 39 No. 16, Schirmer 1904, public domain).
